section.content: 本发明涉及电化学领域，特别是涉及一种锂离子电池及其制备方法。本发明提供一种锂离子电池，包括正极极片和负极极片，所述正极极片包括正极集流体以及位于正极集流体至少一个表面的正极活性物质层，所述负极极片包括负极集流体以及位于负极集流体至少一个表面的负极活性物质层，所述正极活性物质层中粘结剂在活性物质层的厚度方向为均匀分布，所述负极活性物质层中粘结剂在活性物质层的厚度方向为均匀分布。本发明通过将粘结剂预先包覆在活物质表面，再将包覆有粘结剂的活物质涂布制作电极，从而可以防止粘结剂随溶剂挥发而上浮，改善功率和循环，应用于高单位面积活性物质重量体系，可以有效改善由于极片增厚而导致的功率和循环恶化。

The invention relates to the field of electrochemistry, in particular to a lithium ion battery and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a lithium ion battery, which comprises a positive pole piece and a negative pole piece, wherein the positive pole piece comprises a positive current collector and a positive active material layer positioned on at least one surface of the positive current collector, the negative pole piece comprises a negative current collector and a negative active material layer positioned on at least one surface of the negative current collector, a binder in the positive active material layer is uniformly distributed in the thickness direction of the active material layer, and a binder in the negative active material layer is uniformly distributed in the thickness direction of the active material layer. According to the invention, the adhesive is coated on the surface of the active substance in advance, and then the active substance coated with the adhesive is coated to manufacture the electrode, so that the adhesive can be prevented from floating upwards along with the volatilization of the solvent, the power and the circulation are improved, the electrode is applied to a high unit area active substance weight system, and the power and the circulation deterioration caused by the thickening of the pole piece can be effectively improved.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The invention relates to the field of electrochemistry, in particular to a lithium ion battery and a preparation method thereof.

Background

With the application and popularization of power batteries in electric vehicles, the energy density of a battery core is paid more and more attention and challenged, under the work of continuously improving and increasing the energy density, the most effective scheme is to increase the weight of active substances of a cathode in unit area (the increase amplitude is more than or equal to 40%) under the existing applicable system, the use amount of a current collector substrate and a diaphragm substrate can be reduced to a great extent, the saved space is used for increasing the energy density, and various problems can be caused after the weight of the active substances in unit area is increased, for example: the process problem is as follows: after the coating and baking of the pole piece, serious cracking problems occur due to the increase of stress, which greatly hinders the weight of the active substance with high unit area of the cathode (more than or equal to 360mg/1540.25 mm)2) Thereby hindering the magnitude of the increase of the cell energy density; performance problems due to increased active material weight per unit area will lead to increased electrode transport paths and henceDegrading power and cycle.

Disclosure of Invention

In view of the above-mentioned drawbacks of the prior art, an object of the present invention is to provide a lithium ion battery and a method for manufacturing the same, which solve the problems of the prior art.

In order to achieve the above and other related objects, in one aspect, the present invention provides a lithium ion battery, including a positive electrode plate and a negative electrode plate, where the positive electrode plate includes a current collector and a positive active material layer on at least one surface of the current collector, the negative electrode plate includes a current collector and a negative active material layer on at least one surface of the current collector, a binder in the positive active material layer is uniformly distributed in a thickness direction of the active material layer, and a weight of the active material per unit area of the positive active material layer is 360mg/1540.25mm2The above.

The invention provides a lithium ion battery on the other hand, which comprises a positive pole piece and a negative pole piece, wherein the positive pole piece comprises a positive current collector and a positive active material layer positioned on at least one surface of the positive current collector, the negative pole piece comprises a negative current collector and a negative active material layer positioned on at least one surface of the negative current collector, a binder in the negative active material layer is uniformly distributed in the thickness direction of the active material layer, and the weight of the active material in the unit area of the negative active material layer is 180mg/1540.25mm2The above.

In another aspect, the present invention provides a method for preparing a lithium ion battery, including at least one or more of the following steps:

a) providing a positive active material uniformly coated with a binder;

b) a negative electrode active material uniformly coated with a binder is provided.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial effects:

the invention coats the adhesive on the surface of the active substance in advance, and then coats the active substance coated with the adhesive to manufacture the electrode, thereby preventing the adhesive from floating upwards along with the volatilization of the solvent, improving the power and the circulation, and being applied to the heavy active substance with high unit areaQuantitative system (for example, cathode is 360mg/1540.25mm or more2The anode is more than or equal to 180mg/1540.25mm2) And the power and cycle deterioration caused by thickening of the pole piece can be effectively improved.

Detailed Description

The lithium ion battery and the method for manufacturing the same of the present invention are explained in detail below.

The invention provides a lithium ion battery, which comprises a positive pole piece and a negative pole piece, wherein the positive pole piece comprises a positive current collector and a positive active material layer positioned on at least one surface of the positive current collector, and the negative pole piece comprises a negative current collector and a negative active material layer positioned on at least one surface of the negative current collector. In the lithium ion battery, the positive electrode active material layer contains a binder, the binder in the positive electrode active material layer is uniformly distributed in the thickness direction of the active material layer, and the weight of the active material per unit area of the positive electrode active material layer is 360mg/1540.25mm2The above; and/or the negative electrode active material layer contains a binder, the binder in the negative electrode active material layer is uniformly distributed in the thickness direction of the active material layer, and the weight of the active material per unit area of the negative electrode active material layer is 180mg/1540.25mm2The above. The positive electrode active material layer and/or the negative electrode active material layer may be a layer body in general, a thickness direction thereof is generally perpendicular to an extending direction of the layer body, the binder is uniformly distributed in the thickness direction of the active material layer generally means that a content of the binder in the active material layer is substantially uniform in the thickness direction thereof, and specifically, a rate of change in the content of the binder in the active material layer in the thickness direction thereof may be 150% or less, 140% or less, 130% or less, 120% or less, or 110% or less, the rate of change being obtained by calculation using the following formula: the rate of change (binder content in the active material on the side away from the current collector layer/binder content in the active material layer on the side close to the current collector layer) × 100%, and since the binder is a light component in the coating process, it can be reflected by the above formula whether the binder is uniformly distributed in the active material layer. In the lithium ion battery provided by the invention, the positive pole piece and/or the negative pole piece can be a high unit surfaceActive material weight system, for example, the active material weight per unit area of the positive electrode active material layer may be not less than 320mg/1540.25mm2、≥340mg/1540.25mm2、≥360mg/1540.25mm2、≥380mg/1540.25mm2Or more than or equal to 400mg/1540.25mm2For another example, the weight of the active material per unit area of the negative electrode active material layer may be 140mg/1540.25mm or more2、≥160mg/1540.25mm2、≥180mg/1540.25mm2、≥200mg/1540.25mm2Or more than or equal to 220mg/1540.25mm2The electrode is prepared by coating the active substance coated with the adhesive on the surface of the active substance in advance, so that the phenomena that a light component (such as the adhesive) floats upwards along with volatilization of a solvent, a heavy component (such as the active substance) sinks and the like in the coating process can be prevented, the power and the circulation of the electrode can be improved, and particularly when the electrode is applied to an electrode of an active substance weight system with a high unit area, the power and the circulation deterioration caused by thickening of a pole piece can be effectively improved.

In the lithium ion battery provided by the invention, the cohesive force of the positive active material layer can be 30-50N/m, 35-45N/m, 30-35N/m, 35-40N/m, 40-45N/m or 45-50N/m, and the characterization method of the cohesive force of the active material layer can refer to the embodiment part of the invention. The cohesion of the negative electrode active material layer may be 40 to 60N/m, 45 to 55N/m, 40 to 45N/m, 45 to 50N/m, 50 to 55N/m, or 55 to 60N/m. The value of the cohesive force of the active material layer usually affects the adhesive force between the active material layer particles and the particles, mainly depends on the type and the dosage of the binder, the excessive cohesive force may cause the dosage of the required binder to increase, the active material to easily agglomerate and the like, the production problems such as particle scratch and the like are more easily caused in the coating process, and the excessive content of the binder may cause the increase of the ion diffusion resistance in the electrode and the deterioration of the power performance of the battery core; too low cohesion of the active material layer may result in weak adhesion between particles, easy occurrence of production problems such as powder falling during production, and deterioration of cell performance (e.g., capacity, power, cycle, etc.), and the like.

In the lithium ion battery provided by the invention, the positive electrode active material layer can be of a single-layer structure or a multi-layer structure, the binder in at least part of the positive electrode active material layer is uniformly distributed in the thickness direction of the positive electrode active material layer, when the positive electrode active material layer is of a multi-layer structure, the content of the binder in each layer can be the same or different, and the type of the binder in each layer can be the same or different. In an embodiment of the present invention, when the positive electrode active material layer has a multilayer structure, the binder content in at least a part of the layers is the same, and preferably, the binder content in each layer is the same. In another embodiment of the present invention, when the positive electrode active material layer has a multilayer structure, the types of the binders in at least some of the layers are the same, and preferably the types of the binders in the layers are the same.

In the lithium ion battery provided by the invention, the negative electrode active material layer can be of a single-layer structure or a multi-layer structure, the binder in at least part of the negative electrode active material layer is uniformly distributed in the thickness direction of the negative electrode active material layer, when the negative electrode active material layer is of a multi-layer structure, the content of the binder in each layer can be the same or different, and the type of the binder in each layer can be the same or different. In an embodiment of the present invention, when the negative electrode active material layer has a multilayer structure, the binder content in at least a part of the layers is the same, and preferably, the binder content in each layer is the same. In another embodiment of the present invention, when the negative electrode active material layer has a multilayer structure, the types of the binders in at least some of the layers are the same, and preferably, the types of the binders in the respective layers are the same.

In the lithium ion battery provided by the invention, the binder in the active material layer is uniformly distributed in the thickness direction of the active material layer, so the content of the binder in each positive electrode active material layer and/or each negative electrode active material layer is preferably controlled to be the same and consistent, otherwise, the phenomenon of uneven distribution of the binder of the electrode can occur, and the power performance and the cycle performance of a battery cell are deteriorated. In addition, it is preferable that the control of the binder type in each of the positive electrode active material layer and the negative electrode active material layer be uniform, because the ion diffusion ability of the binder is affected by the difference in binder properties (for example, molecular weight, intrinsic binding power, and the like).

In the lithium ion battery provided by the invention, the binder can be matched with the active material generally, for example, the binder can be coated on the surface of the active material particles to form a binder coating layer. Those skilled in the art can select suitable binders suitable for the present invention, for example, the binder selected in the positive active material layer can be one or more of polyvinyl alcohol, polyurethane, polyacrylate, polyvinylidene fluoride, styrene butadiene rubber, epoxy resin, vinyl acetate resin, chlorinated rubber, etc., and for example, the binder selected in the negative active material layer can be one or more of methyl, carboxyl, carbonyl, nitrile, etc., and can be one or more of benzene rubber, polyacrylic acid, acrylate, styrene, phenyl propylene, butadiene, acrylonitrile, acrylic acid, acrylamide, methyl acrylate, ethyl acrylate, methyl methacrylate, etc.

In the lithium ion battery provided by the invention, the mass percentage content of the binder in the positive electrode active material layer can be 0.3-5%, 0.5-3%, 0.3-0.5%, 0.5-1%, 1-1.5%, 1.5-2%, 2-3%, 3-4%, or 4-5%. The content of the binder in the positive electrode active material layer can be generally adjusted by the weight of the binder coated on the surface of the active material during the production process. The content of the binder in the negative electrode active material layer may be 0.5-8%, 0.8-5%, 0.5-0.6%, 0.6-0.8%, 0.8-1%, 1-1.5%, 1.5-2%, 2-3%, 3-4%, 4-5%, 5-6%, or 6-8%. The content of the binder in the anode active material layer may be generally adjusted by the weight of the binder coated on the surface of the active material during the preparation process. The content of the binder in the active material layer generally affects the feasibility of the electrode process and the performance of the battery cell, the increase of the binder dosage may cause easy agglomeration of active materials, the production problems such as particle scratch and the like easily occur in the coating process, meanwhile, the too high content of the binder causes the increase of the ion diffusion resistance in the electrode, the power performance of the battery cell is deteriorated, in addition, the content of the binder also affects the cohesive force of the electrode, the cohesive force affects the adhesion between particles of the active material layer, the too low cohesive force causes the insecure adhesion between the particles, the production problems such as powder falling and the like easily occur in the production process, and the performance (such as capacity, power, circulation and the like) of the battery cell is deteriorated.

In the lithium ion battery provided by the invention, the positive electrode active material can be various positive electrode active materials suitable for lithium ion (secondary) batteries in the field, and for example, the positive electrode active material can include but is not limited to the positive electrode active material with the chemical formula of LiaM1-xM’xO2Wherein a is not less than 0.9 and not more than 1.1, x is not less than 0 and not more than 0.1, M is at least one of Co, Mn and Ni, M is one or a combination of more of Co, Mn, Ni and the like, and M' is one or a combination of more of Al, Mg, B, Zr, Si, Ti, Cr, Fe, V, Cu, Ca, Zn, Nb, Mo, Sr, Sb, W, Bi and the like), and LiFeyMn1-y-zM”zPO4/CbThe lithium iron phosphate material (b is more than or equal to 0, M' is selected from one or a combination of more of Cr, Mg, Ti, Al, Zn, W, Nb and Zr, y is more than or equal to 0.1 and less than or equal to 1.0, and z is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 0.9), and the like.

In the lithium ion battery provided by the present invention, the negative active material may be any kind of negative active material suitable for lithium ion (secondary) batteries in the art, and the negative active material is generally a material capable of accepting and extracting lithium ions, for example, the negative active material may be one or more of graphite, soft carbon, hard carbon, carbon fiber, mesocarbon microbeads, silicon-based materials, tin-based materials, lithium titanate, or other metals capable of forming an alloy with lithium. The graphite can be selected from one or more of artificial graphite, natural graphite and modified graphite, the graphite can be further modified, the modification mode of the graphite is not particularly limited, the graphite is preferably subjected to coating modification on the surface of a graphite core, and more preferably subjected to coating modification by amorphous carbon; the silicon-based material can be one or more selected from simple substance silicon, silicon-oxygen compound, silicon-carbon compound and silicon alloy; the tin-based material can be one or more selected from simple substance tin, tin oxide compound and tin alloy.

In the lithium ion battery provided by the present invention, the positive electrode active material layer and/or the negative electrode active material layer may further include a conductive agent, and the conductive agent may be various conductive agents suitable for lithium ion (secondary) batteries in the art, for example, a combination including but not limited to one or more of acetylene black, conductive carbon black, carbon fiber (VGCF), Carbon Nanotube (CNT), ketjen black, and the like. The weight of the conductive agent can account for 1-10%, 1.5-5%, 1-1.5%, 1.5-2%, 2-3%, 3-5%, or 5-10% of the weight of each material layer of the active material layer.

In the lithium ion battery provided by the present invention, the positive electrode current collector may be generally a layer body, the positive electrode current collector may be generally a structure or a part that can collect current, and the positive electrode current collector may be various materials suitable for being used as a positive electrode current collector of a lithium ion battery in the art, for example, the positive electrode current collector may include, but is not limited to, a metal foil, and more specifically, may include, but is not limited to, a copper foil, an aluminum foil, and the like.

In the lithium ion battery provided by the present invention, the negative electrode current collector may be generally a layer body, the negative electrode current collector is generally a structure or a part for collecting current, and the negative electrode current collector may be various materials suitable for being used as a negative electrode current collector of a lithium ion battery in the art, for example, the negative electrode current collector may include, but is not limited to, a metal foil, and more specifically, may include, but is not limited to, a copper foil.

The lithium ion battery provided by the invention can also comprise other components which can be used for the lithium ion battery, for example, a battery diaphragm, electrolyte, an external electrode, a tab, a packaging shell and the like. The separator may be any material suitable for a separator of a lithium ion (secondary) battery in the art, and for example, may be one or a combination of more of polyethylene, polypropylene, polyvinylidene fluoride, aramid, polyethylene terephthalate, polytetrafluoroethylene, polyacrylonitrile, polyimide, polyamide, polyester, natural fiber, and the like, including but not limited to. The electrolyte may be any of various types of electricity suitable for lithium ion (secondary) batteries in the artThe electrolyte solution, for example, generally includes an electrolyte and a solvent, and the electrolyte may generally include a lithium salt, and more specifically, the lithium salt may be an inorganic lithium salt and/or an organic lithium salt, and the like, and specifically, may include, but is not limited to, LiPF6、LiBF4、LiBOB、LiAsF6、Li(CF3SO2)2N、LiCF3SO3、LiClO4One or more lithium salts, and the like. For another example, the concentration of the electrolyte may be 0.8 to 1.3 mol/L. The solvent may be any solvent suitable for the electrolyte of lithium ion battery in the art, and the solvent of the electrolyte is generally a non-aqueous solvent, and preferably may be an organic solvent, and specifically may include, but is not limited to, one or more of ethylene carbonate, propylene carbonate, butylene carbonate, pentylene carbonate, dimethyl carbonate, diethyl carbonate, dipropyl carbonate, ethyl methyl carbonate, and the like, or halogenated derivatives thereof.

The second aspect of the present invention provides a method for preparing a lithium ion battery, comprising at least one or more of the following steps:

a) providing a positive active material uniformly coated with a binder;

b) a negative electrode active material uniformly coated with a binder is provided.

In the preparation method provided by the present invention, a person skilled in the art can select a suitable method to provide an active material uniformly coated with a binder, for example, the binder and the active material may be mixed, desolventized, and ball-milled to provide active material particles uniformly coated with the binder, and for example, in the active material coated with the binder, the weight ratio of the binder to the active material may be 1: 90-100, 1: 93-99, 1: 90-93, 1: 93-96 and 1: 96-99, or 1: 99 to 100, for example, the mixing of the binder and the active material may be performed in the presence of a solvent, which is generally a good solvent for the binder, so that the binder can be uniformly coated on the surface of the active material.

The preparation method provided by the invention can also comprise the following steps: the pole piece is prepared by the active material coated with the binder. The method of preparing the electrode sheet by the binder-coated active material should be known to those skilled in the art, and for example, the binder-coated active material may be mixed with other electrode materials (e.g., conductive agent, etc.) to coat the electrode. The process of coating the electrode is generally carried out in the absence of a solvent, and the main purpose of the process is to eliminate the problem of floating of the binder due to solvent volatilization.

The preparation method provided by the invention can also comprise the following steps: and preparing the lithium ion battery through the pole piece. Methods for preparing lithium ion batteries from electrode sheets are known to those skilled in the art, for example, the positive electrode sheet, separator and negative electrode sheet may each be a laminate, and thus may be cut into a target size and then stacked in sequence, and may be further wound to a target size for forming a cell, and may be further combined with an electrolyte to form a lithium ion battery.

The embodiments of the present invention are described below with reference to specific embodiments, and other advantages and effects of the present invention will be easily understood by those skilled in the art from the disclosure of the present specification. The invention is capable of other and different embodiments and of being practiced or of being carried out in various ways, and its several details are capable of modification in various respects, all without departing from the spirit and scope of the present invention.

It is to be understood that the processing equipment or apparatus not specifically identified in the following examples is conventional in the art.

Furthermore, it is to be understood that one or more method steps mentioned in the present invention does not exclude that other method steps may also be present before or after the combined steps or that other method steps may also be inserted between these explicitly mentioned steps, unless otherwise indicated; it is also to be understood that a combined connection between one or more devices/apparatus as referred to in the present application does not exclude that further devices/apparatus may be present before or after the combined device/apparatus or that further devices/apparatus may be interposed between two devices/apparatus explicitly referred to, unless otherwise indicated. Moreover, unless otherwise indicated, the numbering of the various method steps is merely a convenient tool for identifying the various method steps, and is not intended to limit the order in which the method steps are arranged or the scope of the invention in which the invention may be practiced, and changes or modifications in the relative relationship may be made without substantially changing the technical content.

The treatment method of the binder and the active material in the embodiment is specifically as follows:

mixing a cathode active material LFP and a binder polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) according to a weight ratio of 98: 2, fully stirring in an N-methyl pyrrolidone solvent (the solvent dosage is controlled according to 70% of solid content, when the solid content is calculated, the binder part is calculated as a solid part, the same below) system, stirring and mixing for 60-150min, controlling the stirring linear speed to be 4-10m/min, filtering by adopting three layers of filter paper after uniform mixing to obtain treated active substances, then putting the treated active substances into a vacuum oven at 45 ℃ for baking for 24h, transferring the treated active substances into a high-speed ball mill for ball milling after baking, controlling the rotating speed to be 600r/min, and taking out after ball milling for 12-15h to obtain the cathode active substances LFP with the surface being treated by 2% of the binder.

Mixing a cathode active material LFP and a binder polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) according to a weight ratio of 95: and 5, fully stirring in an N-methyl pyrrolidone solvent (the solvent dosage is controlled according to 70 percent of solid content), stirring and mixing for 60-150min, controlling the stirring linear speed to be 4-10m/min, filtering by adopting three layers of filter paper after uniform mixing to obtain treated active substances, then putting into a vacuum oven at 45 ℃ for baking for 24h, transferring the treated active substances into a high-speed ball mill for ball milling after drying, controlling the rotating speed to be 600r/min, taking out after ball milling for 12-15h, and obtaining the cathode active substance LFP with the surface being treated by 5 percent of binder.

Mixing a cathode active material LFP and a binder polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) according to a weight ratio of 90: fully stirring 10 in an N-methyl pyrrolidone solvent (the solvent dosage is controlled according to the solid content of 70%), stirring and mixing for 60-150min, controlling the stirring linear speed to be 4-10m/min, filtering by adopting three layers of filter paper after uniform mixing to obtain treated active substances, then putting into a vacuum oven at 45 ℃ for baking for 24h, transferring the treated active substances into a high-speed ball mill for ball milling after drying, controlling the rotating speed to be 600r/min, taking out after ball milling for 12-15h, and obtaining the cathode active substance LFP with the surface being treated by 10% of a binder.

Preparing anode active substance artificial graphite and binder Styrene Butadiene Rubber (SBR) according to the weight ratio of 95: and 5, fully stirring in a deionized water solvent (the solvent dosage is controlled according to 50 percent of solid content) system, stirring and mixing for 60-150min, controlling the stirring linear speed to be 4-10m/min, filtering by adopting three layers of filter paper after uniform mixing to obtain treated active substances, then putting into a vacuum oven at 45 ℃ for baking for 24h, transferring the treated active substances into a high-speed ball mill for ball milling after drying, controlling the rotating speed to be 600r/min, taking out after ball milling for 12-15h, and obtaining the anode active substance artificial graphite with the surface being treated by 5 percent of binder.

Comparative example 1

Untreated LFP cathode sheet (active weight per unit area 300mg/1540.25 mm)2) There is a solvent system:

lithium iron phosphate active material LiFePO4The weight ratio of the conductive carbon black Super-P to the adhesive polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) is 94: 3: 3 stirring in N-methyl pyrrolidone solvent system for 60-150min at 4-10 m/min.
